rule: Status advances only with an evidence path produced by a check that someone other than the implementing pass can rerun. 'exercised_fixtures' means synthetic data only.

features.name: Supplier CSV/XLSX import with Arabic headers, Arabic-Indic digits, currency strings, ambiguous dates
features.acceptance: Mixed Arabic/English template parses; each invalid row has a remediation note; 100 rows with 2 invalid identifies rows 18 and 59.

features.name: Stage → preview → four-eyes publish; re-plan inside publish transaction
features.acceptance: Uploader cannot publish own batch; nothing public before publish.

features.name: Replay idempotency (file hash + offer-fact hash); evidence age from asserted date
features.acceptance: Identical or renamed file returns same batch; same facts new bytes = unchanged; stale sheet does not refresh confirmation.

features.name: Availability ordering rules (late/duplicate/correction)
features.acceptance: Sold then older available then duplicate: no reopen, no second event; newer correction with reason reopens.

features.name: Two sellers, one physical unit; conflicting description held for review
features.acceptance: 1 unit, 2 listings; conflicting type row = conflict.

features.name: Full snapshot vs partial import; suspicious-change acknowledgement; batch revert
features.acceptance: Missing rows withdraw only in full snapshot; >30% withdraw or >20% price move needs ack; revert restores prior version and emits a correction.

features.name: Deterministic cash-flow engine (cashflow-1.0.0)
features.acceptance: EGY-Q1: 8,520,000 total; 1,700,000 through 2027; 820,000 on 2030-01-01; unknown parking → 8,400,000 + unresolved; rental, rounding, discount-basis cases.

features.name: Public API v1: listings search (Arabic variants, aliases), detail with versions, plan, cashflow, changes
features.acceptance: Search finds التجمع / القاهره الجديده / Fifth Settlement; withdrawn offer 404.

features.name: Android list + detail, bilingual, RTL, offline cache with fetch time, env badge
features.acceptance: Fresh install fetches from dev API on emulator; detail shows exactly one price change after revision + replay.

Privileged second factor for console
Compare 2–4 units, shortlist, revocable share links
